summary: Wallowa County lookout: 1932-34 cabin and pole tower, 82-ft tower built 1964, destroyed in a 1967 forest fire and never replaced; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: 82-foot treated-timber R-6 tower with cab (built 1964); earlier 14x16 cabin (1933) and 50-foot pole tower with cab (1934)
facts.status_note: Destroyed in a 1967 forest fire and never replaced; no source describes what remains at the site today

corrections.why: 15.2 m is 50 feet, the 1934 pole tower. The tower destroyed in 1967 was the 82-foot treated-timber tower built in 1964, which is 25.0 m.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: A 1932 Weebly timeline and a 1954 forest history say the cabin and tower were built in 1932. The register and firelookout.com give a 14x16 cabin in 1933 and a 50-foot pole tower in 1934. Not resolved; the story gives both.
The register and firelookout.com date the 82-foot tower to 1964. A 1963 annual report quoted on Weebly mentions one new tower. Not resolved; the record uses 1964.

The 1954 forest history gives Charles V. Marks as the lookout; firelookout.com gives Charlie W. Marks. The 1967 lookout fireman is Vernon Wadman in the Record-Courier item and Keith Wadman on firelookout.com. Not resolved; the story avoids the names.

notes_for_editor: Three sources describe the site. The register and firelookout.com agree on the 1933 cabin, 1934 pole tower, 1964 tower and 1967 fire loss. The Weebly 1932 build date, the 1963 annual report and the 1954 personnel history do not match them and are flagged. The brief's height_m of 15.2 is the 1934 pole tower; the 82-foot tower is 25.0 m. The record's 'gone' status holds; no source describes the site today or whether it is open. No photo or access source was read; the Fire Lookout Museum photo credit on firelookout.com was not checked.
